# `aitbc compliance classify`

Normalize a data classification label to the canonical format.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc compliance classify [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--label` | text | — | yes | The Label. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc compliance classify --label <label>
```
